name: paprika-inc
description: Inspect repository-defined companies and plan setup without activating roles or services.

interface.longDescription: Read-only first slice for local Codex. Show commands, validate a selected repository's portable company definition, inspect declared roles, and prepare a setup plan. A valid definition is not enrollment, adoption, verified project membership, or runtime readiness. The self-contained kit includes both skills, its command helper, a pinned Messenger service-selection component, and the navy Paprika icon. Lifecycle, authenticated service discovery, App binding, installation, deployment, and automatic receiving remain pending. No separate Messenger plugin installation is required for these read-only commands.
